info.title: heddle — render a Heddle template against a JSON model (T4-successor codegen).
info.description: Heddle template-engine CLI: render a template against a JSON model (a T4-successor codegen tool).

options.name: --model-json
options.description:
JSON file whose object is the template model (objects -> members,
arrays -> @list/@for, scalars -> primitives). Omit for a model-less template.

options.name: --out
options.description: Write output to this file instead of stdout.

options.name: --root
options.description: Resolver root for @partial/@<< imports (default: the template's directory).
